we developed a light-activated, spatiotemporality controlled nanomedicine that can be used to treat TNBC by combining three therapeutic modalities.

the core-shell nanoparticles (CDTNs) can be activated by light to kill the peripheral cells of metastatic TNBC by PDT and to kill the deep cells by enhancing the efficacy of chemotherapy and gene therapy.
